records.answer: Gutless says the timing of a water preload should depend on your age because gastric emptying, which refers to the rate at which food and fluid leaves your stomach, tends to slow down as you get older. This means that younger individuals (in their 20s and 30s) will benefit more from a water preload consumed immediately before a meal, while older individuals (40s, 50s, or beyond) can expect to see benefits with water consumed anywhere between 30 minutes and immediately prior to a meal.
